title: Merge Sorted Array
problem: Given two sorted integer arrays nums1 and nums2, merge nums2 into nums1 as one sorted array. nums1 has size m+n where first m are elements to merge.
expected_input: nums1: list[int], m: int, nums2: list[int], n: int
hints: Start merging from the end of the arrays to avoid overwriting elements in nums1.
expected_approach: Three pointers starting from indices m-1, n-1, and m+n-1 working backwards.
